    Coverage, missing fields & sources

    Observations are obtained from OGIMET’s UK and Republic of Ireland METAR and SYNOP downloads, plus SHIP and BUOY reports covering the last six hours. Land SYNOP reports are retrieved for 24 hours to include temperature extremes and daily summaries. Marine coverage is 47.5–62.5°N, 17°W–6°E. Numeric marine identifiers are shown as buoys/platforms; callsigns are shown as ships. Marine position and readings come from the latest report for that identifier, so moving sites are not mixed with earlier positions. Nearby reporting sites may share a WMO/ICAO identifier; these are combined using OGIMET’s station directory. Closed stations and sites with no usable report are not added as fictional observations.

    The observation menu includes fields present in the retrieved reports. Temperature extrema, grass minimum and 24-hour sunshine/radiation switch the age limit to 24 hours when selected. Extremes are reported summary values; their duration follows national practice and is not encoded in the temperature group. Supplementary and national groups and subsurface ocean profiles are available as original codes rather than guessed measurements. All precipitation periods supported by the report are selectable.

    Combined view uses the latest reported value for each variable within the selected age limit. Partial reports do not erase earlier readings; each reading keeps its original time. All times shown are UTC. An absent value, missing gust, NIL report or obscured sky is never changed into a measured zero.

    Cloud amount in SYNOP is reported in oktas. METAR cloud categories describe layers or aviation-significant cloud; CAVOK, NCD and NSC do not mean 0% total cloud. QNH and SYNOP mean sea-level pressure are shown separately.

    Relative humidity is derived from reported temperature and dew point unless reported directly. Apparent temperature and day/night are not station measurements. Separate rain, shower and snowfall amounts are not consistently supplied by these reports, so they are not fabricated. Weather codes can describe rain, showers or snow without measuring the amount.

    Reports refresh every 10 minutes while this page is visible. OGIMET downloads are cached for up to 10 minutes to limit repeated requests. Delivery delays and station outages can occur.

    Reports and station metadata: OGIMET · Data use and attribution. Reports originate from the respective national services. Geography: Natural Earth.

    For weather exploration; not an operational aviation briefing.
